test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 04 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
In a certain code language

A + B means ‘A is the mother of B’

A – B means ‘A is the sister of B’

A × B means ‘A is the wife of B’

A ÷ B means ‘A is the son of B’

Based on the above, how is Z related to W if ‘Z × Y ÷ X − V + W’?
solution:

**Given:** Z × Y ÷ X − V + W 

Z × Y → Z is the wife of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/031c97980f94d38fdb0afb7792ccfeea113f83d99e6e97588fb6d7b570cb366d.png] 

Y ÷ X → Y is the son of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3022041a94f662960e04d56004264282b6f27f02448710173250825923270007.png] 

X − V → X is the sister of V.

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/921be6fecd244ac9b405a988f67e64e9237be021d153ca5b7a0b37edf0c8a757.png] 

V + W → V is the mother of W.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0ce43430e186f153718e54b11a8435bce74eabe1df45644143f7954b3e111bcc.png] 

Here, Z is the mother’s sister’s son’s wife of W.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option - (3)".
